description.text: Research fields 1. Long-span Bridge Design Theory 2. Bridge Structural Dynamics, Stability and Spatial Non-linear Analysis 3. Bridge Construction Techniques and Project (intelligent) Control Techniques 4. Bridge Structural Damage, Disaster Analysis, Reinforcing and Health Test 5. Design Theory and Key Construction Techniques for Tunnels and Underground Works Major courses Numerical Analysis, Matrix Analysis, Mathematical Statistics, Mathematical Equations, Elastic and Plastic Mechanics, Structural Finite Element Analysis, Bridge Design Theory, Modern Tunnel Engineering Techniques and Applications, etc. Degree Award Master of Engineering

duration.text: The Highway and Railway Engineering at Huazhong University of Science and Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5277 USD/per year ￥ 38000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) 2. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5. Letter of recommendation

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 or above 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 3. Hold a Bachelor's degree.
